title: G7 agrees to release 100 million barrels of oil and diesel
summary: BRUSSELS >> Group of Seven countries agreed today on the release of 100 million barrels of diesel and crude oil from emergency reserves in a move cheered by President Donald Trump as he seeks help to cool off surging fuel prices linked to the Iran war.
author: Reuters
